answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before trading, tied to a slowly earned reputation record rather than a free account name. A newcomer starts with only a whisper of trust: it may take tiny jobs, but larger work unlocks only after peers attest completed tasks. Mass-producing fake identities then costs real timber, locked capital and time, instead of being free. Like a comet, a fresh identity that appears, grabs one payout and vanishes leaves no trail worth trusting, so valuable work flows to agents with a durable, checkable history.
